text: Alex Chen: Heads up — staging docusaurus build failing with a bunch of broken anchors after the API reference PR merged. getting 404 jumps in the generated TOC. Priya Nair: ah — do you have a failing link or stack trace? Alex Chen: pasted the relevant chunk: `WARN: anchor mismatch: expected '#/api/client.create' but generated '#/api/client.create​'` Jamie Ortiz: that looks like a stray zero-width char (ZWJ/ZWSP) sneaking into the heading id. which file? Alex Chen: `docs/api/client.md` — there's an inline HTML snippet we added for the param table: `` not sure how it landed there, probably from a copy-paste from the spec. Morgan Lee: ok. easy fix: strip invisible chars from heading IDs during build or nuke the inline id. i can open a quick PR to remove the span. Priya Nair: prefer to patch the source rather than hack the build for now — less blast radius. +1 to Morgan's PR. Jamie Ortiz: I'll add a lint rule to detect non-printable chars in MD headings so it doesn't recur. low-effort regex in docs linter. Morgan Lee: opening PR now — #4123. patch removes the inline span and regenerates anchors. also added a comment about not inserting manual ids. docs-bot: CI: docs/build-staging failed for commit a1b2c3 — 1 failing job (linkcheck). logs: `linkcheck: 1 broken fragment in docs/api/client.md: line 42` Alex Chen: thanks. Morgan, once #4123 is green can you also push a tiny note in the PR description about the root cause (ZWSP in copy-paste) so support can search? Morgan Lee: done. updated PR desc + cc @Jamie Ortiz for linter follow-up. Jamie Ortiz: I'll follow up with a separate PR for linter rule — ref #4125. will include a test case with a zero-width space and one with a soft hyphen. Priya Nair: also check the mkdocs redirects for older permalinks — if the slug changed we might need a redirect entry. Alex Chen: good call. Morgan — can you run the local linkcheck after your change and confirm no new slugs changed unexpectedly? Morgan Lee: ran `yarn docs:linkcheck` locally, no errors, slugs stable. pushed — CI rerun. docs-bot: CI: docs/build-staging succeeded for PR #4123 — all checks passed :tada: Alex Chen: great. thanks everyone. leaving follow-ups: Jamie to add linter, Priya to sweep other manual ids, Morgan to merge. Priya Nair: i'll grep for `id="` and run a quick audit across `docs/` for any non-ascii id tokens. will report back in this thread. Morgan Lee: merging in 10m after CI completes. Alex Chen: awesome, this should clear the production link noise — please ping if any redirected anchors pop up in customer reports.
